note: T-AVT-08f. Avatar Moment scripts. Placeholders only: {first_name}, {coach_name}, {why}, {step_title}, {step_minutes}, {smaller_minutes}, {streak_days}, {time_of_day}, {weekly_count}. A variant is used only when every placeholder in it has a value. Invitations, never orders or guilt; about an 8th-grade reading level. review_status: pending until the clinical team approves; prod uses approved only (dev may use pending). Listed for review in REVIEW.md.
when: Right after a check-in with a good mood (4 or 5) and no gentle day
